plain_english_policy: This bill expands a state income tax deduction for small businesses in Alabama that pay health insurance premiums for their employees.
policy_direction_if_enacted: Enactment would allow qualifying employers (those with fewer than 25 employees) and qualifying employees to deduct up to 100% of the cost of certain employer-provided health insurance premiums from taxable income, doubling the previous deduction limit which was capped at 50%. This change applies retroactively to tax years beginning after December 31, 2008.
sponsorship_supports_position: The sponsors affirmatively advanced a policy that increases the financial benefit available to small businesses and low-to-moderate income employees regarding health insurance costs.
evidence_quotes: "This bill increases the state income tax deduction allowed under Section 40-18-15.3 that qualifying employees and employers may claim for the cost of paying health insurance premiums."
"To amend Section 40-18-15.3, Code of Alabama 1975, to increase, from 50 percent to 100 percent of the cost of certain health insurance premiums, the benefit for qualifying employees and employers."
